newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 19.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Two landowners agree to sell land for Narita airport expansion project and relocate.
-- Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp to forge Internet linkups with leading Asian telecommunications firms.
-- Administrative reform council agrees on creation of cabinet coordination entity.
-- Health and Welfare Ministry presents guidelines for organ transplants from brain-dead patients.
